theme: **The week the tools started working for the tools.** This week's ten are dominated by skills, studios and dashboards that make AI coding agents smarter, safer and more productive - and three of them are things JJ can install himself.
method: **How this week was picked:** 5 of 7 sources scanned (GitHub Trending, Trendshift, skills.sh, findarepo, Hacker News). YouTube was unreachable (CAPTCHA). GitHub API enrichment used the GitHub MCP tool for the top 40. No repos in data/tips.md this week. 12 candidates cleared every floor; 10 picked. No candidates under 45 days old were available for the 'new this week' slots. **Every repo here passed our safety check on Sep 27.** Tencent/WeKnora was on the blocklist (2 unpatched advisories including 1 critical).

picks.name: HyperFrames
picks.oneliner: Write HTML and CSS, and it renders a finished MP4 video - built for AI coding agents to make videos without a video editor.

picks.name: archify
picks.oneliner: Describe a system or process in plain English and your AI agent draws an interactive diagram you can export.

picks.name: VoiceStudio
picks.oneliner: A free, local alternative to ElevenLabs: clone voices, dub videos, transcribe audio and make audiobooks in 646 languages.

picks.name: ECC
picks.oneliner: A set of skills that makes your AI coding agent faster, smarter and more secure - install them and it just works better.

picks.name: open-code-review
picks.oneliner: Alibaba's code-review tool that reads your changes and leaves precise, line-by-line comments - like a tireless reviewer.

picks.name: ponytail
picks.oneliner: A skill that makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev: the best code is the code you never wrote.

picks.name: Univer
picks.oneliner: Spreadsheets, docs, slides, tables and PDF in one open-source kit that AI agents can read and write.

picks.name: i-have-adhd
picks.oneliner: A skill that stops your AI coding agent from burying the answer in paragraphs - it gives you the action, then the why.

picks.name: OpenMAIC
picks.oneliner: Type a topic and it builds you an interactive classroom - slides, quizzes, simulations and projects - in one click.

picks.name: Atlas
picks.oneliner: A dashboard that tracks what your AI coding agents changed, when, and why - like version control for the AI era.
